Script.name: uiSetup
updateStatus
Script.script:
function updateStatus(statusUpdate) hpbar:setValue( tonumber(hp), tonumber(hpmax), "
HP: " .. hp .. " / " .. hpmax .. "
" ) spbar:setValue( tonumber(sp), tonumber(spmax), "
SP: " .. sp .. " / " .. spmax .. "
" ) epbar:setValue( tonumber(ep), tonumber(epmax), "
EP: " .. ep .. " / " .. epmax .. "
" ) infolabel:echo( "Exp: " .. comma_value(exp) .. "
Gold: " .. comma_value(cash) .. "
Bank: " .. comma_value(bank) .. "
Align: " .. colorAlignment() .. "
Remaining Carry Weight: " .. weightLeft .. "" ) end
